parse_predictions_3d: parse 3D object detection predictions to oriented bounding box parameters and suppress overlapping boxes
parse_groundtruths_3d: parse ground truth labels to oriented bounding box parameters for 3D object detection evaluation
calculate_average_precision: calculate average precision and mean AP metrics for 3D object detection using the APCalculator class
flip_point_cloud_axes: flip point cloud coordinates between camera and depth axis conventions using flip_axis_to_camera or flip_axis_to_depth
compute_softmax_numpy: compute softmax probabilities from raw logits using the numpy softmax function for classification scores
